summaries.Good news: Love finds a second act: two retirees discovered romance at 88 after meeting at the gym, proving it's never too late for new beginnings. Japan's potato harvest bounced back to a decade-high, offering hope that agricultural resilience is still possible despite climate challenges.
summaries.Ideas: The design world is pushing back against AI mediocrity—luxury brands are betting on handmade authenticity, Canva is tackling graphic design slop, and Mozilla is fighting to rescue the internet from algorithmic decay. Meanwhile, a new Eames museum campus promises to encapsulate a century of visionary design thinking.
summaries.Technology: Wearable screens are weaving into fabric itself, AI satellites are generating responses from space, and the robotics industry is racing toward humanoid helpers in everyday life. Security threats are mounting as AI agents and extensions become infiltration vectors, requiring new standards for opting out of data scraping.
summaries.Design: Architects are reimagining intimate spaces—from quiet garden studios to covered outdoor living rooms—while Foster + Partners' new Milan stadium and Dubai Design Week celebrate bold geometric expression. Design thinking is expanding into AI experience design and wellness tracking that ditches screens entirely.
